[i]Broodmother offers offensive and supportive utility with her Sentry Turrets and Cocoon Shell abilities that make her a zone control specialist.[/i]

[h2]Base Stats[/h2]

[list]
[*] Structure - [b]6600[/b]
[*] Shield - [b]2100[/b]
[/list]

[b][h2]Weapon - Plasma Spitter[/h2][/b]

[h4]Mod: Swarm[/h4]

[b]Base Stats [/b] 

[list][*]Damage: [b]175[/b]

[*]Magazine: [b]20[/b]

[*]Crit multiplier: [b]0.8[/b]

[*]Quick Reload: [b]No[/b] [/list]

[b]Effect 1[/b]
[list] [*] Every hit increases damage by [b]2%[/b], stacking up to [b]10[/b] times. Resets on reload. [/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]
[list] [*] Every [b]10[/b] hits on an enemy Hunter increases the Ability Power of the next Cocoon by [b]10%[/b], stacking up to [b]4[/b] times. [/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]
[list][*] Critical Hits have a [b]40%[/b] chance of restoring [b]1[/b] ammo to the magazine.[/list]

[h4]Mod: Colony[/h4]

[b]Base Stats[/b]

[list][*] Damage: [b]156[/b]
[*] Magazine: [b]20[/b]
[*] Crit multiplier: [b]0.8[/b]
[*] Quick Reload: [b]No[/b][/list]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] Hits heal Brood Turrets for [b]35[/b]% of damage done.[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] Hitting enemies with [b]5[/b] consecutive shots increases Brood Turret damage done to them by [b]5%[/b] for [b]6s[/b], stacking up to [b]5[/b] times.[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] Hitting [b]3[/b] Critical Hits on an enemy causes Brood Turrets to prioritize them if they are within [b]120m[/b].[/list]

[h2][b]Ability 1 - Brood Turret[/b][/h2]

[b]General[/b]

[list][*] Maximum Turrets deployed: 2[/list]

[h4]Mod: Stinger[/h4]

[b]Base Stats [/b]

[list][*] Damage: [b]300[/b]
[*] Range: [b]120m[/b]
[*] Turret HP: [b]4000[/b]
[*] Cooldown: [b]25s[/b]
[*] Charges: [b]2[/b]
[*] Duration: [b]120s[/b][/list]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] If Broodmother is within [b]50m[/b] of a Turret for [b]10s[/b], it's max Structure increases by [b]800[/b], stacking up to [b]3[/b] times.[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] Enemies hit by a rocket take [b]50[/b] damage per second for [b]3s[/b], stacking up to [b]4[/b] times.[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] If Broodmother is under [b]35%[/b] Structure, Turrets deal [b]20%[/b] more damage and have [b]20%[/b] increased fire rate.[/list]

[h4]Mod: Sacrifice[/h4]

[b]Base Stats [/b]

[list][*] Damage: [b]30[/b]
[*] Range: [b]120m[/b]
[*] Turret HP: [b]4000[/b]
[*] Cooldown: [b]25s[/b]
[*] Charges: [b]2[/b]
[*] Duration: [b]120s[/b][/list]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] After being deployed fire rate is increased by [b]80%[/b] for [b]6s[/b].[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] When out of combat, Turrets have a [b]15m[/b] repair aura that restores [b]100[/b] Structure per second to Broodmother and teammates.[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] Turret damage is increased by [b]10%[/b]. This is doubled when both Turrets are deployed.[/list]

[b][h2]Ability 2 - Cocoon[/h2][/b]

[h4]Mod: Chrysalis[/h4]

[b]Base Stats[/b] 

[list][*] Shell Structure: [b]4000[/b]
[*] Healing: [b]280[/b] Structure per second
[*] Completion Bonus: [b]1000[/b] Structure
[*] Radius: [b]75m[/b]
[*] Cooldown: [b]60s[/b]
[*] Duration: [b]8s[/b][/list]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] Cocoon restores an additional [b]60[/b] Structure per second.[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] When Cocoon ends, Broodmother and nearby teammates restore an additional [b]2500[/b] Structure.[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] When Cocoon ends, Broodmother gains [b]25%[/b] damage resistance for [b]5s[/b].[/list]

[h4]Mod: Aurora[/h4]

[b]Base Stats[/b] 

[list][*] Shell Structure: [b]4000[/b]
[*] Healing: [b]280[/b] Structure per second
[*] Completion Bonus: [b]40%[/b] Ammo restored to Magazine
[*] Radius: [b]75m[/b]
[*] Cooldown: [b]60s[/b]
[*] Duration: [b]8s[/b][/list]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] Each wave of healing also gives Broodmother's teammates [b]0.5%[/b] increased damage for [b]10s[/b], stacking up to [b]16[/b] times.[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] Increases Ammo restored upon completion to [b]100%[/b].[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] When Cocoon ends, Plasma Spitter does not use any Ammo for [b]5s[/b].[/list]

[h2][b]Mainframe[/b][/h2]

[h4]Mod: Queen[/h4]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] Increases Repair Kit effectiveness by [b]15%[/b].[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] Using a Repair Kit decreases Shield recharge delay by [b]3s[/b] until the end of Battle, stacking up to [b]4[/b] times.[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] Repair Kits can Overcharge Broodmother's Structure by up to [b]25%[/b].[/list]

[h4]Mod: Hive[/h4]

[b]Effect 1[/b]

[list][*] Reduces the cooldown of Cocoon by [b]2s[/b] for every [b]8[/b] hits with Plasma Spitter.[/list]

[b]Effect 2[/b]

[list][*] Every [b]2[/b] uses of Cocoon increases Ability Power by [b]15%[/b], stacking up to [b]3[/b] times.[/list]

[b]Effect 3[/b]

[list][*] Each wave of healing from Cocoon also gives Brood Turrets [b]1.5%[/b] damage resistance for [b]10s[/b], stacking up to [b]16[/b] times.[/list]

[h1] [b]July 22nd 2025 - 0.45 - Release[/b] [/h1]

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/v043_Branded_Asset_850x100_Hunters_6b9bc58c22.png[/img]


[h3] [b]General[/b] [/h3]

[list][*]Unlocked all Hunters and Skins including unreleased ones. Enjoy Fletcher!

[/list] [b]Mobility[/b] 

[list][*]Removed Jump from the Dash charge system; it now has a short cooldown.

[*]Increased Dash speed and distance.

[*]Removed delay effects on Hunter movement.

[*]Improved movement animations for all Hunters.

[*]Updated Supersprint to no longer be interrupted by Dashing.

[*]Updated running and sprinting to be deactivated if the 'Sprint' key is pressed.

[*]Improved recovery speed after falling.

[*]Added air dash animations for Fenris.

[*]Added barrel roll animations for Ursus.

[/list] [b]Shield Update[/b] 

[list][*]Removed critical damage from Hunters while Shields are active.

[*]Removed critical zone visibility while Shields are active.

[*]Added Shield Gating function.

[list][*]If incoming damage exceeds the remaining Shields value the excess damage does not transfer to Structure.

[*]In the future Shield Gating will only trigger after full shield regeneration.

[/list][*]Added critical zones are visible even when not in Zoom Aim for [b]2.5s[/b] after Shields are broken.

[*]Updated Shields to recharge in segments.

[list][*]Delay before shield regeneration starts: [b]15s[/b] 

[*]Time to regenerate the first segment: [b]2s[/b] 

[*]Delay before second segment begins: [b]2s[/b] 

[*]Time to regenerate second segment: [b]3s[/b] 

[*]Delay before third segment begins: [b]6s[/b] 

[*]Time to regenerate third segment: [b]2s[/b] 

[/list][*]Updated delay for Shield recharge from [b]30s[/b] → [b]20s[/b] .

[*]Updated full Shield recharge time from [b]5s[/b] → [b]10s[/b] .

[*]Updated color of damage on Shields to blue.

[*]Added broken shield icon when Shields are destroyed.

[*]Updated Shields to prevent damage interrupting interacting with objects activations of consumables and using abilities.

[list][*]Interactions activations and abilities will be interrupted when Shields are broken.

[/list][/list] [b]Gameplay[/b] 

[list][*]Updated Quick Reload timing to be more forgiving.

[*]Updated text while Melee is on cooldown.

[*]Removed Ability Power scaling from Melee.

[*]Updated Respawn prompt to press instead of hold.

[*]Updated Respawn locations to be further from enemies and lowered height of drop.

[*]Updated Respawn to now provide a full magazine.

[/list] [b]Visuals[/b] 

[list][*]Improved Hunter destruction VFX.

[*]Added an effect when projectiles critical hit.

[*]Added visual effects to weapons during Zoom Aim for all Hunters.

[list][*]Some Epic and Legendary skins have unique effects.

[/list][*]Updated lighting on all default Hunter skins to make them easier to identify during battle.

[*]Added video preview for Hunter abilities by pressing the "F1" Key on the Hunters screen in the Hangar.

[/list] [b]Hangar[/b] 

[list][*]Replaced "Inspect Hunter" tooltip with hotkey in Hangar Hunters and Skins.

[*]Updated Hunter Select to only open through the hotkey and not through clicking on the active Hunter.

[*]Updated camera in Hangar to adjust based on Squad size.

[/list][img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/v043_Branded_Asset_850x100_Hunters_Fenris_1e674ac2c2.png[/img]

[h3] [url=https://promo.steelhunters.com/wgc-client/en/discord/439-known-issues] [b] [u]KNOWN ISSUES[/u] [/b] [/url] [/h3]

[i]We are aware of the current bug with Heartbreaker where the game can crash during Extraction. Unfortunately, it has been a tough bug to squish, but we are committed to rolling out a fix as soon as we can. Our deepest apologies to all of the Heartbreaker mains out there, as well as all of you who were excited about trying Heartbreaker with the unlocked System Trees. We do not recommend playing as Heartbreaker until this is resolved.[/i]

[h2] [b]June 10 2025 – 0.41.3 – Update Notes[/b] [/h2]

[h2] [b]General[/b] [/h2]

You might notice that instead of 0.42 we're sticking with 0.41.3 with updates focused on fixing our largest bugs rather than introducing new features.

We have received a lot of useful and productive feedback in the two months that we've been in Early Access and the development team is currently hard at work deciding on our next steps to temper [i]Steel Hunters[/i] into the best game it can be.

In order to do it right we've revisited our priorities and made the call to assign resources to bigger changes. This means we will not be updating the game with new features for a while. We look forward to revealing our plans to you as soon as our updated vision is underway.

However we do want to implement some of the feedback we've been hearing from the majority of you while we work and so we're removing our main power progression and fully unlocking the System Tree for all Hunters. We will also be including an Arena tier squish with this so there will just be one pool that everyone will be queuing into which should help with matchmaking. This tier will also drop the highest tier of gear so those of you looking for an edge have something to aspire toward.

We are also releasing a new completely free BattlePass: [i]Bedlam[/i]! This will include the usual skins but will also feature Gear and three Constructs so you can take advantage of our System Tree changes.

We hope you enjoy these changes and look forward to the future of [i]Steel Hunters[/i]!

[h3] [b]What happens to my existing progress?[/b] [/h3]

Your current progress as of June 10th will be recorded and kept safe. Although we anticipate significant changes to progression we will make sure to honor and reward the progress you have made in Steel Hunters Early Access. We will of course also take into account any additional progress you make after this update.

[/list]🛈 [i] [b]Heartbreaker's weapon changes[/b] aim to address two key issues raised regarding her Railgun.[/i] 

 [i]First we wanted to remove artificial damage limiters in the form of reverse falloff (a reduction in her damage at close range) and highlight her long-range capabilities by making her the only Hunter without long-range damage falloff. We believe that by introducing the Scope-In mechanic (a base damage increase while scoped) we can increase player agency in close-range encounters—while still ensuring that these situations remain disadvantageous for her preserving her identity as a long-range specialist.[/i] 

 [i]Second Heartbreaker stands out as an outlier in terms of damage output relative to player skill level. We've observed that she excels in the hands of highly skilled players who can consistently land critical hits whereas newer players may struggle to bridge that skill gap. The Scope-In mechanic serves a dual purpose: it reduces the punishment for missing a perfect critical hit offering a leg-up for players still learning her precise weapon while still leaving plenty of room for skill expression.[/i] 

 [i]We embrace the competitive nature of our game and we've ensured that skilled play remains rewarded—fully scoped-in critical hits still deal the same amount of damage. We've also updated her Markswoman Mod which now works in tandem with the newly introduced Scope-In mechanic.[/i]

[/list]🛈 [i] [b]Heartbreaker's weapon changes[/b] aim to address two key issues raised regarding her Railgun.[/i] 
 [i]First we wanted to remove artificial damage limiters in the form of reverse falloff (a reduction in her damage at close range) and highlight her long-range capabilities by making her the only Hunter without long-range damage falloff. We believe that by introducing the Scope-In mechanic (a base damage increase while scoped) we can increase player agency in close-range encounters—while still ensuring that these situations remain disadvantageous for her preserving her identity as a long-range specialist.[/i] 
 [i]Second Heartbreaker stands out as an outlier in terms of damage output relative to player skill level. We've observed that she excels in the hands of highly skilled players who can consistently land critical hits whereas newer players may struggle to bridge that skill gap. The Scope-In mechanic serves a dual purpose: it reduces the punishment for missing a perfect critical hit offering a leg-up for players still learning her precise weapon while still leaving plenty of room for skill expression.[/i] 
 [i]We embrace the competitive nature of our game and we've ensured that skilled play remains rewarded—fully scoped-in critical hits still deal the same amount of damage. We've also updated her Markswoman Mod which now works in tandem with the newly introduced Scope-In mechanic.[/i]

notes.title: v0.41 Version Highlights
notes.notes:
Do you hear that in the distance? That rumbling getting closer every day? Watch out it's the Version Highlights for Steel Hunters version 0.41! And with our new version comes our first new Hunter Taurus! This raging bull of the Syndicate has beef with everything in the Hunting Grounds!

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p01_v041_Branding_Asstes_1920x1080_Version_Highlights_519eef465e.png[/img]

In the words of our devs: "He is big he is mean and he is here to bull-y you! Pun intended... He’s making a headfirst entrance to our roster—just like he loves to dive into battle with his Bull Charge. He isn't afraid to claim the battlefield with his banner Power Pylon and he's ready to back up his smirky comments with his Heavy Shotgun (beware of his zoom!). He’s in your face living on the edge and disrupting everything in his way while he's at it."

Look out for upcoming publications diving deeper into Taurus' kit and playstyle.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p02_v041_Branding_Asstes_1920x1080_Version_Highlights_1be1626711.png[/img]

You're probably wondering how you'll be able to add Taurus to your Hunter roster. For version 0.41 Taurus makes his debut exclusively in our 'Infamous' BattlePass. But don't worry—we're committed to ensuring that [b]all Hunters[/b]  including Taurus  [b]will always have a free path to unlock them[/b] .

For just 100 Platinum—easily [b]obtainable through Combat Missions[/b] —you can upgrade to the [b]PRO BattlePass[/b] . Reach level 59 and Taurus is yours to keep!

Alternatively upgrading to the [b]PREMIUM BattlePass[/b] for an additional 100 Platinum (200 if you skip PRO) grants you [b]instant access to Taurus[/b] . The PREMIUM track also includes exclusive skins credits and plenty of other goodies to unlock as you progress. We've designed the BattlePass to feel valuable and rewarding let us know what you think!

[b]![/b] Should you miss out on this BattlePass Taurus will become available for Constructs like our other Hunters starting in version 0.42.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p03_v041_Branding_Asstes_1920x1080_EN_Version_Highlights_37ed1d5f17.png[/img]

A new version wouldn't be the same without some balance updates! We're still compiling all the information you've been providing since Early Access launched but a common point has been Heartbreaker. She's a bit like marmite: some of you love her some hate her but it's strong opinions all around!

We're rolling out some large updates to her Railgun and Sonar Pulse to help empower her team play. Key points include shifting more power into her scoped fire and adding more support utility into Sonar Pulse.

Just because she's sitting back and laying down precision fire shouldn't mean that her team mate feels alone in the front! You'll be able to see the full scope of these changes in Changelog v0.41 soon.

You might have seen that we're updating the in-game HUD. This is in response to hearing your feedback from our playtests that the center of the screen was too cluttered. We think the new one looks pretty snazzy even for a starting point and there will be more improvements on the horizon. Even this picture is just a work-in-progress and size of abilities and consumables should be larger by the time it's in your hands!

We're also introducing our first pass at our new in-battle Stats screen. With it it should be easier than ever to see how strong you are at any stage of a Battle.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p04_v041_Branding_Asstes_1920x1080_Version_Highlights_e526935730.png[/img]

We've also redone all the models for the all the interactables minus enhancement cores. (Sorry enhancement cores!) We wanted to make sure that even the basic Energy Cell has some Steel Hunters flair and is deserving of its place in the near post-apocalyptic future!

With some awesome new effects included we want to make our game look unique while improving visibility. Is it really worth going after that Special Kit in the middle of a firefight? Well now you can easily tell it's a Shield Dome it might just be!

We'll also be rolling out the first the changes towards what we call Melee 2.0 with version 0.41. We want melee combat to be a satisfying part of your battle plan. Just because you're a 20 foot tall dog with a rocket launcher doesn't mean you shouldn't be able to get up close and personal with your claws!

We're starting small with reductions to cooldown and range and a more reliable prompt to let you know a target is in range. But we want to hear how it feels to you and how you'd like to see it develop from here.

We know that our current progression system can feel a bit jarring. We hear you! We're continuing to look at pain points in the leveling process and will be making changes and adjustments. This kicks off with [b]a 50% Credit cost reduction to all Unique Nodes to balance their cost vs other nodes[/b] .

You can find more information about Unique Nodes and their role in the System Tree article [url=https://steelhunters.com/en/news/400-sys-tre] [u]here[/u] [/url].

Anyone who has purchased of these Nodes in Version 0.40 will be issued a refund for the Credit difference. This is just the starting point for many iterations to come as it [b]is[/b] called Early Access for a reason!

Finally Version 0.41 will include the first iteration of our Shop. Here we'll have skins for all your favorite Hunters available for Platinum. The offers will rotate weekly so just because you don't see what you're looking for immediately doesn't mean it won't be there during Version 0.41 or beyond.

Our team is hard at work cooking up some especially cool skins so jump in when the patch drops and take a look at our sweet shop offers!

Thank you! We can't wait to moo-ove around the Hunting Grounds with the rest of you when Version 0.41 drops at the end of the month. Let us know what changes you're most excited for when the Changelog drops in the near future.

All the best 

Raegnim

Your favorite cat with human ears

notes.title: v0.40 Version Highlights
notes.notes:
Hello everyone this is the Version Highlights for v0.40 (or what we're calling internally the Early Access build)! To both the new players who will be joining us for this exciting step and the old players who have been supporting for a while welcome! Here we'll take a look at what's on the horizon before the Changelog's release and the launch of our permanently live servers on April 2nd. This time we have a rework of our System Trees a return to our classic Last Stand game mode and a whole bunch of graphical improvements so let's dive right in!

First things first we can't wait for you to join us all in Early Access! From April 2nd our servers will be permanently live and you will be free to progress with all your skins from Alpha and Beta Tests. That's right no more wipes! To celebrate this we're happy to debut our Introductory BattlePass which you can unlock the Pro and Premium tiers of for free! This will include a plethora of boosters and skins to get you started. While the Pro will be available for the 10 Platinum you get from completing Training the Premium will be available for a further 10 Platinum. This will be obtainable quickly through just playing the game so don't worry! We want to welcome you to Steel Hunters with a taste of what we're aiming for moving forward.

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p05_v040_Branding_Asstes_Version_Highlights_1920x1080_Battlepass_30d6a90499.png[/img]

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p01_v040_Branding_Asstes_Version_Highlights_1920x1080_System_Tree_c06699205a.png[/img]

Now for the nuts and bolts of the version proper. As part of our ongoing mission to create an exciting and interesting leveling experience we felt it was time to look at the System Trees. Gone are the days of having four separate trees all competing for your System Points (and let's be honest they were all going in your main weapon!). Now we have a single glorious tree filled with nodes providing gradual power to look forward to on your leveling journey. On top of the new Ability Stat nodes each Hunter will have 3 Unique Nodes that will add an extra layer to their capabilities. Some of them are old effects like Heartbreaker spreading her Stealth to her allies but most are all new! Check out a few examples below for Prophet Heartbreaker and Razorside:

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p02_v040_Branding_Asstes_Version_Highlights_1920x1080_Unique_Nodes_c23a0fdee3.png[/img]

The team decided to take this opportunity to also rework Ability Power (AP) and remove it from the System Trees. We don't think you should need a guide to understand a core mechanic and so we've changed it to an "in-battle only" stat. Your AP will increase naturally as you level up and pick up Enhancement Cores helping your abilities scale through to extraction.

You will be able to find more information on these topics in both the Changelog and an upcoming deep dive into the System Tree.

Speaking of the Changelog in it you'll also be able to find our most recent round of balance updates. The main focus of these were to compensate for the new System Tree and Ability Power rework. As there is a lot of moving parts with the new systems there might be some unforeseen consequences despite the best efforts of the Balance Team so we thank you for your understanding in advance. Also as a few of our Hunters had some of their Active Effects converted into the new Unique Nodes in the System Tree they have been replaced with some brand new ones! We look forward to seeing how you make use of all these new tools.

The System Tree isn't the only part of the Hangar that has gotten a fresh coat of paint! Take a look at our new much sleeker Loadout screen:

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p03_v040_Branding_Asstes_Version_Highlights_1920x1080_Loadout_e09cb988ea.png[/img]

Please give a warm Steel Hunters welcome to our new Drones! While we've certainly redone their exterior we've also tweaked the nuts and bolts and given their AI an overhaul. They'll still be joyfully firing their autocannons and launching rocket barrages for now but the new system will give us a lot more power when it comes to creating interesting behaviors in the future!

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p04_v040_Branding_Asstes_Version_Highlights_1920x1080_Drones_After_a5b348b1af.jpg[/img]

[img]https://sh-portal-prod.wgcdn.co/sh-portal-prod/portal_media/p04_v040_Branding_Asstes_Version_Highlights_1920x1080_Drones_Before_d5b0fac5cb.jpg[/img]

You'll probably notice that Starfall Harvest is missing from the Game Mode selection screen. This is intentional! We've received an overwhelming amount of feedback from both the World Premiere playtest and our Clutch Performance Beta Weekend; the team has made the decision to take Starfall back to the lab for a little more iteration. We are committed to making it the primary game mode for Steel Hunters and want it to be the best it can be. In the meantime please enjoy Last Stand our original game mode!

As you may know something we've been cooking for a while is speeding up Steel Hunters without losing our slower tactical feeling. For version 0.40 we're experimenting with near instant pickup speeds for Enhancement Cores Ammo Crates and Energy Cells. We still want you to have to commit to picking up the more impactful items like repairs or consumables but your feedback that you were tired of holding the 'E' key or pressing the 'X' button for every little thing was definitely heard and taken on board. We've also lowered the time before you can start shooting after sprinting or Supersprinting so running and gunning is easier than ever!

[previewyoutube=I0SYyVbOIbA;full][/previewyoutube]

That's all for this time! Keep an eye out for the various articles coming your way on the new System Tree and BattlePass and we'll see you in the Hunting Grounds on April 2nd!

notes.title: v0.39 Version Highlights

Welcome to the Version Highlights for Steel Hunters v0.39! In these sneak peaks we'll be highlighting the big changes coming in each new version before the Changelog releases. For version 0.39 this includes a revamped New Player Experience a streamlined Starfall Harvest and the 'biggest' include (in size not scope) a total rework to Colossus! With that's said let's get into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342863/c66ccb5a436a8132d76ae1f04ccccac411be3f1d.png[/img]

One of the first things that you might notice is that all Hunters have a shorter cooldown on their dash and jump allowing more freedom in both navigating the map and evading enemy fire. The slow and tactical feeling of our gameplay is important so we look forward to hearing how this effects your experience!

After our last playtest we received a lot of feedback on the shortcomings of our Tutorial mission so we're very happy to unveil our Training 2.0! Comprised of Hunter Training and Battle Training this two part experience sees a fully voice-acted Trenchwalker companion teaching you the ropes of both Steel Hunters & the Starfall Harvest game mode! While these missions cannot be completed with a friend we're also happy to announce that in v0.39 you'll be able to squad up as soon as you finish Hunter Training!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342863/405a9d12e2146653be5f7227c07533ea4bc816bb.png[/img]

Along with the the Training changes we've continued iteration on our Account Progression UI. As we steadily move towards launch we're constantly looking to improve clarity and polish in all parts of the Steel Hunters experience. But that's not the only progression system we've been working on. We've taken a look at our Hunter Leveling and sped it up noticeably making it easier than ever dive deeper into the Skill Trees and compete at higher Arena Tiers. Now's the perfect chance to test out those loadouts you've been theory crafting!

We're trying something a bit different with our Starfall Harvest game mode in version 0.39 by removing the third wave entirely. We've paired with this is an increased number of towers spawning in the first wave adding unpredictability to early game encounters. We know that the pacing will be different but as we are in Beta we thought we'd shake things up a bit. For all you fans of the old Starfall don't worry! Nothing is set in stone. We'd love to hear your feedback about this Streamlined Starfall Harvest as we strive for the best possible experience!

Last but certainly not least our devs felt that Colossus was overdue a tune up. Despite its strength a constant complaint from players was that the simplicity of its kit led to a boring play experience. We want you to feel like a boss while transformed into Colossus and so nothing was left untouched. The machine guns? Missiles launchers. His spear stab? Now the Spear Throw ability(!) with different effects based on what it hits! However everything comes with a cost and we're sorry to announce that Colossus no longer holds its trusty shield.
